informational.text: The per-group select-all row of a `ds-multi-select` with `selectAll="group"` or `selectAll="both"` cuts its label to the panel width with an ellipsis, as the top select-all row does, so a long group name no longer scrolls the list sideways.
informational.verify: Open a narrow ds-multi-select with selectAll="both" and a long group name and confirm the group's select-all row ends in an ellipsis and the list has no horizontal scrollbar.

informational.text: `--ds-dropdown-panel-min-width` defaults to `220px` and floors the `ds-select`, `ds-multi-select` and `ds-autocomplete` panel in both `width` modes, so a panel under a trigger narrower than 220px is 220px wide; a wider trigger still sets the width. Set `--ds-dropdown-panel-min-width: 0` on the component to keep a panel as wide as its trigger.
informational.verify: Open a ds-select narrower than 220px and confirm its panel is 220px wide, then open one beside the right edge of the viewport and confirm the panel stays on screen.

informational.text: A `dsColumnSeries` in a `ds-chart` whose `cursor` is `'category'`, or resolves to it under `'auto'`, brightens the column at the category under the pointer, as a hovered column does under `cursor="none"`.
informational.verify: Hover a category of a ds-chart holding a dsColumnSeries and a dsLineSeries and confirm the column at that category brightens.

informational.text: The `ds-time-picker` hour and minute columns that hold more values than they show run on past either end: after the last value the first comes round again, the selected value is scrolled to the middle of its column, and the column shows no scrollbar. `loop="never"`, or `DsConfig.timePicker.loop: 'never'`, keeps them as lists.
informational.verify: Open a ds-time-picker, scroll the hour column past its last hour and confirm the first hour follows, then reopen it and confirm the selected hour sits in the middle of the column.
